changelog: **Marketing import: `contract_ends_at`** (#2844, decision #2572 Q7). A won customer who already gave notice imports with the day the contract ends (`MentorshipRelation.contractEndsAt`, #2841); the column is refused on any row that is not `DEAL_WON`, and follows the import's one overwrite policy (gaps only unless authoritative). `customer_since` and `trial_ends_at` already shipped in #2554, so the cutover (#2555) now has every column the decision asks for.

en: The account import takes the day a customer’s contract ends, so customers who already gave notice arrive with their notice period.
tr: Hesap içe aktarımı müşterinin sözleşme bitiş gününü alır; fesih bildirmiş müşteriler ihbar süreleriyle birlikte gelir.
de: Der Account-Import übernimmt das Vertragsende, sodass Kunden, die bereits gekündigt haben, mit ihrer Kündigungsfrist ankommen.
